prompt_package.goal_summary: Build one reusable style reference image that makes every future image look like the same brand.

user_profile.who: Anybody who wants a consistent look across many images

blocks.task: Create a brand style reference plate for {{brand}}. It is a design tool, not an ad. It shows the visual rules in one image.
blocks.subject: A clean 3-panel layout on {{background_color}}. Left panel: the three brand colors as large flat swatches with small hex-style labels. Middle panel: three sample shapes or products in the brand look. Right panel: a short type specimen using the words {{type_sample}}.
blocks.scene: Wide flat plate, thin hairline dividers between panels, generous margins, no photography, no people, no logos other than {{brand}} wordmark at the top left.
blocks.camera: Straight-on flat view, no perspective, no shadows, no paper texture, no mockup frame.
blocks.light: Even, flat illumination. Colors must be exact and unmodified.
locks: The three swatches are {{primary_color}}, {{secondary_color}} and {{accent_color}}. They must be flat and clean.
Layout stays a three-panel grid with hairline dividers.
No extra text beyond the brand name and the type sample.
avoid: gradients or textures on the swatches

input_schema.description: Fill this once per brand. Save the result; you will reuse it forever.

output_schema.description: The plate, plus how to use it.

fields.name: use_as
fields.example: Attach as reference image 3 in every other package.

example_output.use_as: Reference image 3 for product, ad and social packages.
Reference image 3 for book and social packages.

non_obvious_insights: This is the highest-leverage package here. One plate reused as a reference in every other prompt buys consistency across a whole catalog.
Color names are ambiguous. Add hex codes into the image as tiny labels, then sample the real pixels afterward with any color picker.
Never attach more than one style plate at a time. Two plates average into a third style you did not choose.
A three-panel layout forces the model to hold color, form and type at once, which is exactly what a brand is.
Regenerate the plate when the brand changes, not the individual images. One update cascades.
Say 'design tool, not an ad' in the task line. Otherwise the model adds marketing copy you did not ask for.
monetization_ideas: Sell a brand starter kit: style plate, color list, type rules, and five image packages.
Offer a 'consistency audit' to brands whose images drift across channels.
Give the plate free and charge for the image sets that use it. It makes the value visible.
License the plate-plus-JSON bundle to agencies as an internal standard.
Use the plate as the cover of a paid template pack; it is the proof of quality.
prompt_package.reusability_notes: Build one plate per brand, product line or campaign. Attach it as the last reference image in product, social and ad packages. To extend: add a fourth panel with sample layouts at 16:9, 4:5 and 9:16 so every channel inherits the same proportions. Keep the plate in the same folder as the memory file so a session always starts with both.
